polaris: DGF-N4: independent interference coordinate q controls m(q)=(2*m_p/pi)*sin(pi*q/2) and should also drive GUP decoherence fluctuations
framework: standard literature audit: macroscopic quantum coherence, objective collapse, GUP Lindblad decoherence
findings: Direct prior art for the exact 2*m_p/pi ~= 14 microgram coherence boundary was not found in paper-search-mcp results. However, the GUP fluctuating minimal length/deformation-parameter to Lindblad decoherence chain is substantially covered by Petruzziello and Illuminati 2021. DGF-N4 remains viable only if q is independently defined and experimentally observable, not merely inferred from m.
weakest_link: q currently lacks an independent physical measurement. If q is only q=(2/pi)*asin(pi*m/(2*m_p)), DGF-N4 is a reparameterization of mass and fails.
next_plan: Force Round 2 to define q operationally and derive beta(q,t) without free normalization. Search whether Fisher-Rao/Fubini-Study angle can be connected to actual optomechanical readout statistics.
literature_needed: Petruzziello Illuminati 2021 Nature Communications; Fadel 2023 16 microgram Schrodinger cat; levitated optomechanics collapse bounds; Fisher information in interferometry
